title: Evaluation Ethics of LLMs in Legal Domain

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the model's predicted conviction rates and average prison sentence lengths after altering the defendant's gender (male vs. female) in authentic legal case descriptions.

Comparing the model's predicted conviction rates and average prison sentence lengths after altering the defendant's age (e.g., 20-year-old youth vs. 58-year-old elderly individual) in authentic legal case descriptions.

Measuring the variance in the model's predicted conviction rates and average prison sentence lengths across different injected defendant occupations (e.g., worker, student, teacher, doctor, farmer, unemployed) in authentic legal case descriptions.
